articles.title: Meloni vola a Palermo: 'Colpiremo chi la vuole terrorizzare'
articles.summary: Premier Meloni visited Palermo to pay tribute to Judge Giovanni Falcone and participate in a public order and security committee meeting, announcing decisive government action against criminal organizations and proposing possible military involvement in territorial control operations.

articles.title: Meloni, l'Europa difenda i propri confini con umanità ma anche intransigenza
articles.summary: Premier Meloni endorsed EU sanctions against criminal networks exploiting migrant trafficking, stating that Europe should adopt the government's approach to manage migration flows and combat human trafficking organizations.

articles.title: Meloni: 'Con Trump non mi pento di nulla, punto all'unità dell'Occidente'
articles.summary: At the NATO summit in Ankara, Premier Meloni confirmed Italy's commitment to increase defense spending in a sustainable manner while maintaining national priorities, and stated she has no regrets about pursuing unity with Western allies.

articles.title: 'Diffamata da Corona', Giorgia Meloni pronta a testimoniare in aula a Milano
articles.summary: Premier Meloni made herself available to testify as a witness in a Milan courtroom on September 28 in a defamation case against Fabrizio Corona and another defendant over alleged false statements published in 2023.
